name: Skirk
description: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts. She bears the title 'Void Star'.

skillTalents.name: Havoc: Sunder
skillTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive attacks.
Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a spinning crystal spear, dealing DMG to opponents ahead.
Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Havoc: Warp
skillTalents.description:
Imitates the combat style of 'The Foul.' Produces different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.
Tap:
Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety and switches to Seven-Phase Flash mode. This mode continuously consumes Serpent's Subtlety, increases Normal/Charged Attack AoE and interruption resistance, and converts attacks to Cryo DMG.
Hold:
Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety and continuously moves at high speed, capable of moving across water. She can end this movement prematurely by using the skill again.
Serpent's Subtlety:
A special resource used to maintain Seven-Phase Flash or cast her Elemental Burst.

skillTalents.name: Havoc: Ruin
skillTalents.description:
Skirk's Elemental Burst does not rely on Elemental Energy but consumes Serpent's Subtlety. When Skirk has at least 50 Serpent's Subtlety, she can expend all of it to unleash Havoc: Ruin, ripping space apart to deal massive AoE Cryo DMG. DMG increases for every point of Serpent's Subtlety consumed above 50.
Havoc: Extinction:
While in Seven-Phase Flash mode, Havoc: Ruin is replaced by Havoc: Extinction. This special burst can be used without consuming Serpent's Subtlety and grants the 'All Shall Wither' effect, increasing Normal Attack DMG.

passiveTalents.name: Reason Beyond Reason
passiveTalents.description: When nearby party members trigger Frozen, Superconduct, Cryo Swirl, or Cryo Crystallize reactions, a Void Rift is created (max 3 exist at once, triggered every 2.5s). Skirk can absorb Void Rifts via Charged Attacks in Seven-Phase Flash, Havoc: Extinction, or Holding her Skill. Each absorbed Rift grants 8 Serpent's Subtlety points.

passiveTalents.name: Return to Oblivion
passiveTalents.description: When nearby Hydro/Cryo party members hit opponents with their respective elements, Skirk gains 'Death's Crossing' stacks (max 3). Each stack increases Skirk's Normal Attack DMG in Seven-Phase Flash by 110%/120%/170% and Havoc: Ruin DMG by 105%/115%/160%.

passiveTalents.name: Mutual Weapons Mentorship
passiveTalents.description: When all party members are either Hydro or Cryo, and there is at least 1 Hydro and 1 Cryo character, party members' Elemental Skill Level is increased by 1.

constellations.name: Far to Fall
constellations.description: Enhances 'Reason Beyond Reason': Every Void Rift absorbed summons a crystal blade dealing 500% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG (considered Charged Attack DMG).

constellations.name: Into the Abyss
constellations.description: After using Havoc: Warp, gains 10 additional Serpent's Subtlety. Havoc: Ruin DMG calculation considers up to 10 extra points. Additionally, using Havoc: Extinction in Seven-Phase Flash increases ATK by 70% for 12.5s.

constellations.name: Serendipitous Sin
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Havoc: Ruin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Fractured Flow
constellations.description: Enhances 'Return to Oblivion': Each Death's Crossing stack also increases Skirk's ATK by 10%/20%/40%.

constellations.name: End of Wishes
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Havoc: Warp by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To the Source
constellations.description: Absorbing Void Rifts grants 'Havoc: Sever' stacks (max 3). Havoc: Ruin consumes stacks to deal 750% ATK as additional Cryo DMG per stack. In Seven-Phase Flash, 3rd/5th Normal Attacks consume a stack to launch coordinated attacks dealing 180% ATK.
